import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Set a random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Generate a synthetic time series dataset
n_periods = 100
dates = pd.date_range(start='2020-01-01', periods=n_periods, freq='M')
values = np.random.normal(loc=100, scale=20, size=n_periods) + np.linspace(0, 50, n_periods)

# Create a DataFrame
seed_df = pd.DataFrame({'Date': dates, 'Value': values})

# Introduce heteroskedasticity by increasing variance over time
seed_df['Value'] += seed_df.index * np.random.normal(0, 1, n_periods)

# Introduce missing values
seed_df.loc[seed_df.sample(frac=0.1).index, 'Value'] = np.nan

# Introduce a canary value
seed_df.loc[seed_df.sample(frac=0.01).index, 'Value'] = 9999

# Rename columns to domain-specific names
seed_df.rename(columns={'Date': 'TransactionDate', 'Value': 'TransactionAmount'}, inplace=True)

# Save to CSV
seed_df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
